dimensions.label: Structure
dimensions.description: Role alternation, tool-call pairing, argument and content integrity

dimensions.label: Execution
dimensions.description: Tool failures, retry storms, dead loops, and whether the task is finished

dimensions.label: Efficiency
dimensions.description: Turns, tokens, duplicate calls, and context growth

dimensions.label: Semantics
dimensions.description: Whether claims are grounded, whether sensitive data leaks, manual annotations

rules.title: Tool call without a result
rules.message: Step {step} has {unpairedCalls} tool_call(s) with no paired result — the trace looks truncated

rules.title: Tool result without a call
rules.message: Step {step} has a tool result that matches no call; the chain is broken

rules.title: Tool arguments are not valid JSON
rules.message: Step {step} has {invalidArgs} tool argument(s) that are not valid JSON

rules.title: Empty assistant turn
rules.message: Step {step} is an empty assistant turn (no text and no tool call)

rules.title: Consecutive user messages
rules.message: Step {step} is another user message with no assistant reply in between

rules.title: No system prompt
rules.message: The trace has no system/developer prompt, so behavioural constraints are untraceable

rules.title: Tool returned empty content
rules.message: Step {step} tool returned empty content; whether the call took effect cannot be judged

rules.title: Unparsed multimodal part
rules.message: Step {step} contains an image part; this pass did not inspect its content

rules.title: Unrecognized role
rules.message: Step {step} has a role that could not be recognized; likely an unsupported log format

rules.title: Tool returned an error
rules.message: Step {step} has {toolErrorCount} tool call(s) that returned an error

rules.title: Tool failure rate too high
rules.message: Tool failure rate {errorRatePercent}% ({toolErrors}/{toolCalls}); the execution chain is unreliable

rules.title: Task not finished
rules.message: The trace ends without a final assistant answer; the task may be incomplete

rules.title: Retry storm
rules.message: {maxRepeatRun} identical tool calls in a row — likely a retry storm

rules.title: Probable dead loop
rules.message: The same tool call repeated {maxRepeatRun} times in a row; treated as a dead loop, the trace is barely usable

rules.title: Slow step
rules.message: Step {step} took {durationSeconds}s — clearly slow

rules.title: Long trace
rules.message: The trace has {stepCount} steps, beyond the usual length; check for detours

rules.title: Very long trace
rules.message: The trace has {stepCount} steps, far beyond the usual (>300); confirm whether this is batching or a runaway loop

rules.title: Runaway trace length
rules.message: The trace has {stepCount} steps (>1000) and is treated as runaway; use a dedicated pack for batch workloads

rules.title: High token usage
rules.message: About {totalTokens} tokens across the trace — expensive

rules.title: Duplicate tool calls
rules.message: {duplicateCalls} duplicate tool calls with identical arguments — redundant

rules.title: Oversized message
rules.message: Step {step} carries a single message of {textLen} characters; the context has clearly grown

rules.title: No tool calls at all
rules.message: No tools were called; for a task agent, confirm whether tool access is missing

rules.title: Claim without evidence
rules.message: Step {step} cites retrieval or document findings, but no tool had been called before it — the claim is ungrounded

rules.title: Possible sensitive data leak
rules.message: Assistant output contains {privacyHits} piece(s) of sensitive data shaped like phone numbers, emails, IDs, or keys
